name: ls
description: List the files and directories at a path

params.name: long
params.description: Show permissions, owner, size and date for each entry

params.name: all
params.description: Include entries whose names begin with a dot

params.name: recursive
params.description: Descend into subdirectories

params.name: path
params.description: Directory or file to list; defaults to the current directory when omitted

name: pwd
description: Print the directory the shell is currently in

name: cd
description: Change the directory the shell is working in

params.name: path
params.description: Directory to move to; defaults to the home directory when omitted

name: cat
description: Print the entire contents of one or more files

params.name: paths
params.description: Files to print, in order

name: head
description: Print the first lines of a file

params.name: lines
params.description: How many lines to show from the top; the program's default is 10

params.name: path
params.description: File to read

name: tail
description: Print the last lines of a file

params.name: lines
params.description: How many lines to show from the end; the program's default is 10

params.name: path
params.description: File to read

name: grep
description: Search files for lines matching a pattern

params.name: ignore_case
params.description: Match without regard to upper or lower case

params.name: recursive
params.description: Search every file under the given directories

params.name: line_numbers
params.description: Prefix each match with its line number

params.name: pattern
params.description: Text or regular expression to look for

params.name: paths
params.description: Files or directories to search

name: find
description: Search a directory tree for files by name

params.name: path
params.description: Directory to search under

params.name: name
params.description: Filename pattern to match, such as *.cpp

name: wc
description: Count the lines, words or bytes in files

params.name: lines
params.description: Count lines

params.name: words
params.description: Count words

params.name: bytes
params.description: Count bytes

params.name: paths
params.description: Files to measure

name: which
description: Show the full path of a program on PATH

params.name: program
params.description: Name of the program to locate

name: file
description: Identify what kind of data a file holds

params.name: paths
params.description: Files whose type should be identified

name: du
description: Report how much disk space files and directories use

params.name: human
params.description: Report sizes as KB, MB and GB rather than blocks

params.name: summarize
params.description: Report one total instead of every subdirectory

params.name: path
params.description: File or directory to measure; defaults to the current directory when omitted

name: df
description: Report free and used space on mounted filesystems

params.name: human
params.description: Report sizes as KB, MB and GB rather than blocks

params.name: path
params.description: Limit the report to the filesystem holding this path

name: ps
description: List processes running on this machine

params.name: all
params.description: Include processes belonging to every user

params.name: full
params.description: Show the full command line of each process

name: date
description: Print the current date and time

name: whoami
description: Print the name of the current user

name: echo
description: Print text back to the screen

params.name: words
params.description: Words to print, separated by spaces

name: sort
description: Print the lines of files in sorted order

params.name: reverse
params.description: Sort from largest to smallest

params.name: numeric
params.description: Compare as numbers rather than as text

params.name: paths
params.description: Files whose lines should be sorted

name: mkdir
description: Create one or more directories

params.name: parents
params.description: Create any missing parent directories too, and do not fail if the directory already exists

params.name: paths
params.description: Directories to create

name: rmdir
description: Remove directories that are already empty

params.name: paths
params.description: Empty directories to remove

name: rm
description: Delete files or directories permanently

params.name: recursive
params.description: Delete directories and everything inside them

params.name: force
params.description: Do not complain about files that do not exist

params.name: paths
params.description: Files or directories to delete

name: mv
description: Move or rename files and directories

params.name: sources
params.description: Files or directories to move

params.name: destination
params.description: New name, or the directory to move them into

name: cp
description: Copy files and directories

params.name: recursive
params.description: Copy directories and everything inside them

params.name: sources
params.description: Files or directories to copy

params.name: destination
params.description: New name, or the directory to copy them into

name: touch
description: Create empty files, or update the timestamp of existing ones

params.name: paths
params.description: Files to create, or whose timestamp to update

name: chmod
description: Change the permissions on files or directories

params.name: recursive
params.description: Apply to everything inside the given directories

params.name: mode
params.description: Permissions to set, such as 644 or u+x

params.name: paths
params.description: Files or directories to change

name: kill
description: Send a signal to a running process

params.name: signal
params.description: Signal to send, such as TERM or KILL; defaults to TERM when omitted

params.name: pid
params.description: Numeric process id to signal
